claims.text: ComfyUI published v0.31.0, v0.32.0, and v0.33.1 during the W33 window.
The v0.32.0 release notes add Qwen-Image 3.0 Pro partner nodes, LTX 2.5 support and partner nodes, Grok-Imagine-Image-2.0 partner nodes, and several MiniMax-H3 VAE/memory fixes.

limitations.text: ComfyUI support proves W33 integration/adoption activity only. It does not establish the underlying model release date, first-party capability claims, or X momentum for Qwen-Image 3.0 Pro, LTX 2.5, or Grok-Imagine-Image-2.0.

targets.target: Verify chronology, primary-source identity, technical claims, and overlap before selection.
targets.finding: The three ComfyUI releases and the v0.32.0 integration additions are directly verified from project release notes. Underlying model chronology remains separate.

targets.target: Verify primary source, weekly significance, and whether this is distinct or redundant.
targets.finding: v0.32.0 contains the material W33 media integrations; grouping v0.31/v0.32/v0.33.1 as one ComfyUI series avoids duplicate treatment.

unresolved_questions: Which release-note changes are material enough to survive cross-candidate comparison?

editorial.why_now_note: ComfyUI had multiple W33 releases; v0.32.0 is a concrete integration event for image/video models and directly reopens the image-generation coverage lane that Grok r2 had closed.
editorial.rationale: Candidate as an integration/adoption signal and Lane-D evidence; final ranking awaits Grok r3 X-trend reconciliation.
